title: Exact Nonnegative Matrix Factorization via Cone-Ray Witnesses: Certificates, a One-Sided Solver, and a Findability Phase Transition
summary: We study exact nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) of small exact-rank-r matrices through the polyhedral cones of nonnegative preimages of the truncated SVD. Restricting each factor to an r-subset of a cone's extreme rays collapses the factorization constraint to the entrywise nonnegativity of a single r x r witness matrix; witness feasibility is a certificate that an exact size-r NMF exists, decided in one matrix inverse.
